summary: Attempted to verify /finance route. Page fails to render due to persistent JSX compilation error in FinanceLandingPage.jsx. Overlay 'Compiled with problems' blocks the app. Main agent's claimed fix is NOT effective.

failed.issue: SyntaxError: /app/frontend/src/pages/FinanceLandingPage.jsx: Unterminated JSX contents. (153:10). Root cause on line 152: <footer> uses style as a string (style="background: linear-gradient(...);") instead of a JS object (style={{...}}). React/JSX does not accept string style attributes, causing the parser to fail. Additional inline style strings in the same minified block may need auditing.
failed.evidence: Webpack overlay screenshot on /finance shows: 'ERROR in ./src/pages/FinanceLandingPage.jsx  Module build failed ... SyntaxError: Unterminated JSX contents. (153:10)'. File view confirms line 152 contains style="background: linear-gradient(rgb(67, 23, 113) 0%, rgb(56, 20, 96) 50%, rgb(22, 3, 44) 100%);" as a string literal.

failed.issue: Expected H1 'Nobody moves their money because of an ad.' could not be verified because page never rendered.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/FinanceLandingPage.jsx line 152, convert the <footer style="background: linear-gradient(...);"> string attribute into JSX object form: style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(rgb(67,23,113) 0%, rgb(56,20,96) 50%, rgb(22,3,44) 100%)' }}.
Also scan the file for any other style="..." (string) usages and convert them to style={{...}} objects.
Consider un-minifying the trailing block (lines 152+) so future syntax errors are easier to catch.
